msContents.summary: A paper manuscript of the Itihāsasamuccaya.

support.p: Leaf dimensions from title card, converted from inches.

lg.l: yo rakṣet prāṇinaṃ rājā bhayārttaṃ śaraṇāgataṃ
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ yat syāt tan me brūhi tapodhana || 1

ekataḥ kra
tavaḥ sarve samagravaradakṣiṇāḥ |
ekato bhayabhītasya prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇaṃ || 2
atraivodāraharaṃtīmam itihāsaṃ purātanaṃ |
iṃdrasyāgneś ca saṃvādaṃ śiber auśīnarasya ca || 3

varttamāne ma
hāyajñe jijñāsārthaṃ śiviṃ nṛpaṃ
iṃdraḥ śyenaḥ kapoto gnir bhūtvā tatropajagma||tuḥ || 4
atha taṃ nṛpatiṃ prāha kapotaḥ śyenajād bhayāt |

śaraṇārthaṃ mahīpālaṃ nililye bhayavihvalaḥ
|| 5
tataḥ śanair upāgamya śyenarūpī sureśvaraḥ |
rājānaṃ sumahātmānaṃ provācedaṃ vacas tadā || 6
dharmātmānaṃ tvām ihāhur ekaṃ rājan_ mahībhṛtāṃ |

aṃtaḥ kṣutpīḍyamānasya bhakṣya
tvaṃ me samarpaya || 7
yathātmanaḥ priyāḥ prāṇāḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā
sadā mṛtyubhayatrastās trātavyāḥ prāṇino budhaiḥ || 8

janmamṛtyujarāśokair nityaṃ saṃsāra
sāgare |
jaṃtavaḥ parikliśyaṃti mṛtyos trasyaṃti te tathā || 9
mariṣyāmīti yad duḥkhaṃ puruṣasyopajāyate |
jñeyas tenānumānena paro pi parirakṣituṃ || 10

yathā ca te jīvita
m ātmanaḥ priyaṃ tathā pareṣām api jīvitaṃ priyaṃ |
saṃrakṣase jīvitam ātmano yathā tathā pareṣām api rakṣa jīvitaṃ || 11
mahatām api dānānāṃ kālena kṣīyate phalaṃ |

bhītābhayapra
dānasya kṣaya eva na vidyate || 12
dattam iṣṭaṃ tathā taptaṃ tīrthasevā tathā śrutaṃ |
sarvāṇy abhayadānasya kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīṃ || 13
catuḥsāgaraparyaṃtāṃ yo dadyāt pṛthivīm imāṃ |

abha
yaṃ sarvabhūtebhyas tayor abhayado dhikaḥ || 14
nāto bhūyastaro dharmaḥ kvacid anyo sti bhūtale |
prāṇināṃ bhayabhītānām abhayaṃ yat pradīyate || 15

varam ekasya sattvasya pradattaṃ jīvi
tābhayaṃ |
na ca viprasahasrasya gosahasram alaṃkṛtaṃ || 16
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo yo dadāti dayāparaḥ |
tasya dehād vimuktasya kṣaya eva na vidyate || 17

hemadhenudharādīnāṃ dātāraḥ sulabhā bhu
vi |
durlabhaḥ puruṣo loke sarvabhūtadayāparaḥ || 18
śyenāḥ kapotān_ khādaṃti śrutir eṣā sanātanī |
mā rājan_ sāram ajñātvā kadalīstaṃbham āruha || 19

nā
haṃ kuśāstramārgeṇa kvacid vartte vihaṃgama |
śāstreṇaivopadiṣṭo yaṃ dharmaḥ sattvadayāparaḥ || 20
sarvasattveṣu yad dānam ekasattveṣu yā dayā |

sarvasmād api dānāc ca dayaiva hi viśiṣyate || 2
1
sarve dānā na tat kuryuḥ sarve yajñāś ca khecara |
sarve tīrthābhiṣekāś ca yat kuryāt prāṇināṃ dayā || 22
jaṃgamāni ca bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi ca ye janāḥ |

ātmavat parirakṣaṃti te yāṃti paramāṃ ga
tiṃ || 23
prāṇinaṃ vadhyamānaṃ tu yaḥ śaktaḥ samupekṣate |
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃm iti prāhur manīṣiṇaḥ || 24
samṛddhaṃ sakalaṃ rājyaṃ prayacchāmi tava dvija |

yat tvaṃ kāmaya hy anyad varjayitvā ka
potakaṃ || 25
yadi rājan_ kapotena sudṛḍhā prītir īdṛśī |
tat tvaṃ kapotatulyāni svamāṃsāni prayaccha me || 26
anugraham imaṃ manye yan māṃ śyenābhibhāṣase |

etat te haṃ pra
yacchāmi svamāṃsaṃ yāvad icchasi || 27
adhruveṇa śarīreṇa pratikṣaṇavināśinā
dhruvaṃ yo nārjayed dharma sa śocyo mūḍhcetanaḥ || 28

nātiriktam ahaṃ yāce tava māṃsaṃ na
reśvara |
tasmāt kapotena samaṃ prayaccha tulayā mama || 29
tad evāhaṃ kariṣyāmi yan māṃ śyenābhibhāṣase |
yenāsya rakṣaṇaṃ tu syāt tava bhṛtthir vihaṅgama || 30

evaṃ kṛtvā sva
māṃsāni samutkṛtya sa pārthivaḥ |
prahṛṣṭas tolayāmāsa kapotena saha prabhuḥ ||| 31
dhriyamāṇas tu tulayā kapoto vyatiśiṣyate |
punaś cotkṛtya māṃsāni dadau tasmai sa pārthivaḥ || 32
na vidyate yathā māṃsaṃ kapotena samaṃ kvacit |
tataḥ prakṣīṇamāṃso sāv āruroha tulāṃ svayaṃ || 33
paraduḥkhāturā nityaṃ sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ |

nāpekṣaṃte mahātmānaḥ svasukhā
ni mahāṃty api || 34
tatas tasmin_ samārūḍhe | tulām auśīṇare nṛpe |
devaduṃdubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ca || 35
tatas tasya tadā matvā devarājo dhṛtiṃ parāṃ |

śakraḥ svarūpam āsthāya
vākyam etad ayāṣata || 36
ātmaprāṇaiḥ paraprāṇān_ yo naraḥ parirakṣati |
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yato nāvarttate punaḥ || 37
divyarūpadharas tvaṃ ca pālayitvā tu medinīṃ |

sarvāṃ
l lokān atikramya svargalokaṃ gamiṣyati || 38
